Bed survey, Recension the Tenth

Survey of the bed, Recension the Tenth, as entered. Stakes from the old tree-line, east to west.

Stake 8. An adult, hands crossed, facing the tree-line.
Stake 9. An adult, one hand open. Reading: leaf-light; a name spoken.
Stake 10. Here the survey does not say. The hand changes.
Stake 11. A child, curled, facing the tree-line.
Stake 12. Peat only. Entered as peat.

Margin, in the eleventh hand: stake 10 kept as the tenth left it, blank. At 11 our reading diverges from the tenth's; we read the child as turned toward 9. The two readings are kept side by side, and both are initialled.

sections.Heading: Decision details
sections.Text:
You see a spring trap.
Not loaded.
How to use: From the pack choose load the spring trap and pick what to load it with. Then press C on an open cell beside you and choose lay the trap there (or choose it from the pack). Whoever next steps on the cell springs it. Oil under fire moss burns, and water or brine under spark root shocks. Bare ground is only marked. On water, a frost lichen trap makes ice and can freeze whoever springs it. Before a laid trap springs, stand beside it and choose recover the loaded spring trap. The recovered frame keeps its load for another position.
Needs: one fire moss, frost lichen or spark root in your pack, to load it with.
Cost and limits: Loading spends the cartridge and springing spends the trap. It does not know who laid it: you spring it too. Fire is not laid on the Choir's ground.
Right now you can: load the spring trap with frost lichen.

A frame of seasoned wood and a sprung blade on a catch.
1 unit. Weight per unit: 3. Total weight: 3.
Lift Strength: 3; yours: 16.
You can carry this item.
Grip: one hand.
spring trap cannot be thrown.
Pack weight: 21; with this item: 21. Burden threshold: 240.
